text.tspan: ​VeyraGuardian — Smart IoT Vital Signs Monitoring Wearable for Elderly Care
​This circuit monitors heart rate, SpO2 and body temperature
​in real time, displaying results on a TFT screen.
​Data is sent via BLE to the Edge API and then to the cloud.
​Handles I2C sensors, SPI display and BLE transmission
​MAX30102 — Used to measure heart rate and blood oxygen levels (SpO₂).
​It communicates through the I2C protocol using address 0x57.
